meta.title: DSH Enhanced
meta.description: Two-way session sync across devices over WebDAV or a shared folder, covering sessions, workspaces, attachments and config — plus session delete and recovery, cross-workspace move, and full-corpus search.

nav.title: DSH Enhanced
section.title: DSH Enhanced
section.desc: Session sync, session management and full-corpus search. Syncing uploads sessions, workspaces, attachments and config to the cloud folder you configure.
switch.delete.desc: Adds "Delete session" to the session menu. A running session cannot be deleted.
switch.move.desc: Adds "Move to workspace" to the session menu. The session itself stays the same; only its working directory and grouping change.
switch.trash.desc: Shows the recovery entry in the session menu and on this page. Deleted sessions stay in the local recycle bin.
switch.search.desc: Opens the search panel over any screen and matches session titles and message text.
switch.quote.desc: Right-clicking a selection replaces the browser menu with Copy and Quote; quoting inserts the text into the composer.
field.retention.hint: 0 keeps them until you remove them by hand.
delete.label: Delete session
delete.title: Delete this session?
delete.desc: The local session directory, its projection cache shard, and its workspace reference are removed. The session stays recoverable in the recycle bin until it expires.
delete.done: "{title}" was deleted. You can recover it from Session recovery.
delete.blocked: A running session cannot be deleted. Stop it first.
move.label: Move to workspace…
move.title: Move to workspace
move.desc: Moves the session into the target workspace in place: the session itself is unchanged, only its working directory becomes the target. The app restarts afterwards to apply the new grouping.
quote.label: Quote
quote.noInput: The composer is not ready yet.
trash.title: Session deletions
trash.desc: Sessions deleted in this workspace. Restore one, or remove it permanently.
trash.workspaceGone: The workspace is gone; records for it were removed.
search.hint: Type to search every session. Enter opens the highlighted result.
